children: Zhipu launched its "Citywide Coding Plan" on September 10, offering Coding package subsidies to workers in Hangzhou, students at Hangzhou universities, and companies in Shangcheng District. According to ChainCatcher, individual quarterly and annual card subsidies are 44% and 51%, respectively, while enterprise annual card subsidies are 55%, with a maximum of 1 million yuan per company.

Each individual may use the subsidy once and must choose either the quarterly or annual card. Applicants are required to submit proof of social insurance contributions or a student enrollment verification report.

title: Zhipu Launches Coding Subsidy Program in Hangzhou on September 10
